text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Life is, well...
pretty much like a single "mediocre cinema" film...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Every character is born either having something
or lacking something. And then—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
No major events happening,
just living normally.
In other words, a "thoroughly mediocre cinema."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Still, it happens every now and then.
When we both clash with all our might. That's right..."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Moments that surpass your wildest imagination!
That thrill is what racing is all about...!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Or so I was thinking, you know.
Just zoning out.
choice_data_list: I see... I get what you're trying to say.

text_block_list.text:
Though Transcend isn't officially my trainee yet,
we chat and find common ground again today.

An informant who loves subcultures and adores gadgets. We're on an extraordinarily similar wavelength.
At first glance, she seems rather laid-back, but...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
So, yeah, as far as running goes,
I really do want to run, but...

"She isn't just some lazy Umamusume.
She has a decent amount of passion for running."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: I've got all the info I need for the race—my stats, the rival list, all that. But still...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: When it comes to actually entering a race, there's a lot involved, right? Paperwork, chaperones, and all that. So...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"I feel like it'd be pretty inconvenient if we don't make a contract.
What do you think, Trainie?"
choice_data_list: Agreed. That's why I submitted it.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Huh, you already served it?
choice_data_list: The trainer contract. You gave it to me the other day, right?
The trainer contract. You gave it to me the other day, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: The contract... Ah, come to think of it...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Trainy, hold onto this just in case, okay?
I've already signed it and everything.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Just in case someone asks,
"Why are you hanging around an uncontracted Trainer's office?"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Oh. I see. You signed and
submitted that too, Trainy.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainey.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Now you get it!

They bump their fists together softly.
Without needing to reaffirm their resolve now,
their feelings were already one and the same.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Taaaahhhh...!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
*Haa, fuu*... So, that's why I tried running on
both turf and dirt again, but...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Which direction do you think looks best, Trainer-chan?
Give me some advice!

I gave it serious thought. Transcend would
supplement various information for me,
but the final call rested on the Trainer.
choice_data_list: I think... you're suited for dirt.
I... think I'm suited for dirt

text_block_list.text:
After considering various aptitudes, it felt like
dirt suited her better than turf.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Hmm, hmm. If you think so too, Trai-chan, I trust you completely. Alright, one more lap on the dirt track!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Taaaahhhh...!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... Hey, Trainy,
before we even get to that...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Running isn't really that fun, is it?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, honestly. Training just doesn't get me
pumped the way browsing through
crowdfunding projects does.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Racing is... super interesting, though~.

It doesn't seem like Transcend actually enjoys
running for its own sake.
If that's the case, what is her reason for racing...?
choice_data_list: Does that mean you just like winning?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I might've said this before, but
what I'm more interested in than winning or losing is...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: It's the "thrill" beyond that, you know!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
In that "mediocre cinema" called life,
only predetermined things happen, but...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
If someone serious shows up and I get serious too,
then all of a sudden, there's no telling what might happen.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Isn't that awesome? And racing is what gives us
a peek at "what lies beyond that image"...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
...Honestly, even if you win,
if you don't get that "thrill," maybe it's just no fun?

Not the running or the victory itself,
but that unpredictable thrill. In other words—

Intellectual curiosity toward the unknown. That seems
to be the driving force behind Transcend.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: "Still, it's easy to say, but 'beyond the image'... 'something more thrilling than victory' is..."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trai-chan, do you know what it's like...?
Or is it just a pipe dream?

I have no idea what it actually is.
What Transcend wants to achieve is far more difficult than just winning. But...
choice_data_list: W-Well, let's go search for it together.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trai-chan, you're down for it.
Big help. That's my bestie for ya.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
“Yeah, you're right. With crowdfunding and stuff,
you never know until you dive in headfirst...”

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Besides, it's more fun when you don't know!
Yaaay, let's just go enjoy it!
"And so, in search of unknown thrills, our Twinkle Series journey with Transcend leisurely began."
